hero.subtitle: Where the West Sea meets stillness
hero.title:
A Coast for Slow Reading,
Deep Breath, and Quiet Sunsets
hero.description: Manseok-Hwasu is a coastal escape designed for those who want to disconnect from screens and reconnect with the rhythm of the sea, the sky, and themselves.

visit.title: Plan Your Visit
visit.subtitle: Everything you need before you arrive

directions.title: How to Get Here
directions.description: Detailed directions by car, public transit, and bicycle from major Korean cities.

parking.title: Parking Lot Guide
parking.description: Real-time availability and pinned navigation to all coastal parking areas.

map.title: Area Map
map.description: Full overview of the promenade, reading zones, and surrounding facilities.

waterfront.title: Waterfront Dock
waterfront.description: The Manseok-Hwasu Waterfront Dock is the top local spot for watching the sunset. It provides a wide, open view of the sky and the West Sea, making it easy to capture great photos. It is a go-to destination for anyone looking for the best sunset views and a peaceful sound of waves.

lookout.title: Sea Lookout
lookout.description: Equipped with shared binoculars, this elevated lookout offers a panoramic view of passing ships, distant islands, and the changing tides.

library.title: Coastal Reading Pavilion
library.description: An open-air pavilion stocked with donated books. Pick one up, sit by the railing, and read while the sea reads itself.

cafe.title: Slow Café
cafe.description: A small phone-free café serving hand-drip coffee, seasonal teas, and locally baked bread. Conversation is welcome; notifications are not.

gallery.title: Rotating Art Gallery
gallery.description: A small exhibition space featuring works from local artists, refreshed every season.

bike.title: Coastal Bike Path
bike.description: A 4 km flat path connecting the dock to the southern lighthouse. Bikes are available for free hourly checkout.

reading.title: Reading & Booking
reading.subtitle: Reserve a quiet seat by the sea
reading.premium_subtitle: A reservable, climate-controlled space with sea-view seating
reading.donate_description: Help grow our shared coastal library. Drop off books at the Welcome Pavilion or partner with our local library.

seasonal.title: Seasonal Activities
seasonal.subtitle: The coast changes. So do its rituals.

spring.label: Spring
spring.title: Cherry Walks & Tide Pools
spring.description: Gentle morning walks along the blooming coastal path and afternoon tide pool exploration with local naturalists.

summer.label: Summer
summer.title: Sunset Concerts & Night Reading
summer.description: Acoustic concerts at golden hour and lantern-lit reading sessions stretching late into warm summer nights.

autumn.label: Autumn
autumn.title: Open-Air Chess & Go
autumn.description: Slow, contemplative board games on the wooden deck overlooking the sea, paired with hot tea and seasonal pastries.

winter.label: Winter
winter.title: Quiet Tides & Hot Drinks
winter.description: Bundled coastal walks, the year's clearest stargazing nights, and warm gatherings around the indoor fireplaces.

community.title: Join the Community
community.subtitle: Visitors who came back
community.forum_description: Share photos, reading recommendations, and stories from your visit. Discover what locals love most about this coast.
community.volunteer_description: Help maintain reading zones, lead seasonal events, or support the donated book library.

footer.about_text: A community-led coastal project of Dong-gu, Incheon, dedicated to slow living and shared reading.
